# drawbridge — dating services
#
# Always on, no option behind it, pinned by SHA-256 in dist/policy.json.
#
# **The app side was covered twice and the web side not at all**, which is why
# this file exists as of 2026-08-17. `blocked_packages` names the big apps, and
# the store rule blocks Play's `DATING` category outright — but neither reaches a
# browser, so tinder.com loaded on a locked phone. Every rule in this project has
# to hold in the browser as well as in the launcher, which is the lesson policy
# 55 recorded when Ecosia was dropped from the engine list but left reachable.
#
# **The category rule does not make this redundant, and Grindr is the proof.**
# It is filed under `SOCIAL` on the Play Store rather than `DATING`, so a rule
# keyed on the category misses it entirely. The same will be true of the next
# one, because the category is chosen by the publisher.
#
# The popular set is small and this list covers it. The long tail is regional,
# low-traffic and endless, and will stay leaky in the way games.txt is leaky —
# that is a known property, not a defect to be fixed by adding a thousand names.
#
# Every domain below was fetched on 2026-08-17 and its page title had to be the
# service it claims to be, which is the rule policy 59 established after
# com.saylo.app resolved to a different app of the same name.

# --- the international majors ---
tinder.com
bumble.com
hinge.co
badoo.com
pof.com
zoosk.com
eharmony.com
happn.com
lovoo.com
jaumo.com
hily.com
boo.world
coffeemeetsbagel.com
theinnercircle.co
raya.app
tantanapp.com
feeld.co

# --- filed as SOCIAL on the Play Store, so the category rule misses them ---
grindr.com
weareher.com

# --- Benelux and French-language, which the international lists never carry ---
meetic.be
meetic.fr
lexa.nl
parship.be
parship.com
twoo.com

# --- Behind bot protection, so the title could not be read.
# Included anyway: each name is distinctive enough to belong to nothing else,
# which is the same call made for hiwaifu.com in ai-companions.txt. ---
okcupid.com
match.com
ashleymadison.com
